Messages.Body:
I just want to make sure: is it possible to play a Blur after playing
Projectile at superior? My gut tells me no, because the Projectile
extra strike is already counted as the extra strike.

I guess the way to go is to play Projectile at inferior, and then play
Blur; that way, instead of two strikes, I get three.

Messages.Author: Hardy Range
Messages.Body:
Grey Wanderer wrote:
> I just want to make sure: is it possible to play a Blur after playing
> Projectile at superior? My gut tells me no, because the Projectile
> extra strike is already counted as the extra strike.
>

No, you cannot. Your gut is not a LSJ, but it is correct.

6.4.3. Strike
[...] A minion cannot use more than one card or effect to gain
additional strikes per round of combat.

Hardy Range
